purpose: Teach: アポロ/ライナー/ゼット/ナカ/シマ/鞭/ハンドブック/さらし

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、理科の授業で、本気で、絶対、アポロ、絶対、計画、絶対、習ったよね
lines.en: Riku — you definitely learned about the Apollo program in science class, right?
lines.style: Bright and direct, leaning in with genuine curiosity. Quick tempo, playful lilt on the question-tag. She's testing him, but warmly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。試合で、本気で、絶対、ライナー、絶対、ヒット、絶対、打ったんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. I hit a liner drive that game, Sakura. Dead serious.
lines.style: Understated pride beneath the surface. Steady, almost off-hand delivery on the fact itself. Slight warmth when he says her name — he knows she'll understand what it meant.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前のチーム名、本気で、絶対、頭文字、絶対、ゼット、絶対、入ってるよね、リク
lines.en: Your team's name — it's got the letter Z in it, doesn't it, Riku?
lines.style: Slower, more thoughtful. She's working something out as she speaks. Gentle curiosity, not interrogation. Like she's seeing something she'd forgotten about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ナカイ、本気で、絶対、先生、絶対、俺たちの、絶対、担任、絶対、なんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Nakai-sensei's our homeroom teacher, you know that, Sakura.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, but with a quiet undercurrent of affection. He's stating something true. No performance, just — stating it. Direct eye contact in his voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 動物園で、本気で、絶対、シマウマ、絶対、ぼくたち、絶対、見たことあったよね、リク
lines.en: We saw zebras at the zoo together once, didn't we, Riku?
lines.style: Nostalgic, almost wistful. Softer attack. She's remembering something small and real. The words come slower, like she's holding onto the moment. Small smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 歴史の授業で、本気で、絶対、武士の、絶対、鞭、絶対、習ったよな、桜
lines.en: We learned about samurai weapons in history class — remember, Sakura?
lines.style: Quieter than before. He's reaching back to something. The delivery is gentle, almost tentative. He's not showing off — he's offering a memory, seeing if she remembers too.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 生徒会の、本気で、絶対、ハンドブック、絶対、お前、絶対、作ってくれたよね、リク
lines.en: You made that student council handbook for us, didn't you, Riku?
lines.style: Warm recognition, genuine gratitude underneath. She's not just stating it — she's honoring what he did. Steady, clear, with a note of real affection. No irony here.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 文化祭の、本気で、絶対、暖簾、絶対、さらし布、絶対、染めるんだぜ、桜
lines.en: We're dyeing the noren curtain with bleached cloth at the festival, Sakura.
lines.style: Animated and present, almost excited beneath the cool exterior. He's imagining it as he speaks. Slightly quicker pace, breath carrying the momentum. The close of something — both an ending and a beginning.
